{{nihongo|'''Kashima Onata Shrine'''|鹿島緒名太神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Miyagi Prefecture|Q47896|qid=Q47896}} {{ill|Watari District, Miyagi|Q1131765|qid=Q1131765}} {{ill|Watari, Miyagi|Q1205296|qid=Q1205296}}. {{nihongo|'''Kashima Onata Shrine'''|鹿島緒名太神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mutsu Province]].
Its {{ill|Q712534|lt=former shrine ranking}} was village shrine. It is one of the four {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki}} for {{ill|Watari District, Miyagi|Q1131765|qid=Q1131765}}.

== Enshrined deity ==
; {{ill|Takemikazuchi|lt=Takemikazuchi|Q1502690|qid=Q1502690|qid=Q1502690|lt=Takemikazuchi}}
: There is a theory that the name of Kashima Onata Shrine, like {{ill|Kashima Amatarashi Wake Shrine|Q11677110|qid=Q11677110}}, is derived from the name of Onata-no-kami, a child deity of Takemikazuchi.

== History ==
According to shrine tradition, the shrine was established by imperial decree on the 6th day of the 8th month in the 41st year of {{ill|Emperor Keikō|ar|الإمبراطور كيكو|arz|الامبراطور كيكو|azb|کیکو (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Keikō|cs|Keikó|de|Keikō|es|Keikō Tennō|fa|امپراتور کیکو|fr|Keikō (empereur)|hr|Keikō|hu|Keikó japán császár|id|Kaisar Keikō|it|Keikō|ja|景行天皇|ka|კეიკო|ko|게이코 천황|nds|Keikō|nl|Keiko (keizer)|no|Keiko (keiser)|pl|Keikō|pt|Imperador Keikō|ru|Император Кэйко|sh|Car Keikō|simple|Emperor Keikō|sl|Cesar Kejko|sv|Keiko (kejsare)|th|จักรพรรดิเคโก|tl|Emperador Keikō|tr|Keikō (imparator)|uk|Імператор Кейко|uz|Imperator Keikō|vi|Thiên hoàng Keikō|yo|Emperor Keikō|zh|景行天皇|zh_min_nan|Keikô Thian-hông|zh_yue|景行天皇|qid=Q329723}}'s reign. It is designated as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki}}, and in ancient times the entire Koyama district was shrine territory. Later, during the wars of the {{ill|Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Q1145058|qid=Q1145058}} era, the shrine lands fell into disuse. In {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 5 (1872), the shrine was ranked as a {{ill|Q712534|lt=village shrine}}. Kashima Onata Shrine, together with {{ill|Kashima Amatarashi Wake Shrine|Q11677110|qid=Q11677110}}, is considered to be one of the two shrines enshrined in {{ill|Watari District, Miyagi|Q1131765|qid=Q1131765|lt=Watari District}} among the "thirty-eight shrines enshrining descendant deities of the great Kashima deity in Mutsu Province" recorded in the "{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}}."
